about: Broken fact sheets for the two contract checks (spec_country.md A8.5): each case names one mutation of the synthetic United States sheet (scripts/88 --synthetic), applied by tests/testthat/test-country-check.R to country_check_sheet() and by dashboard/src/country/__tests__/contract.test.ts to checkFactSheet(); both must report a problem whose text contains `keyword`.

cases.what: the first placed sector's corner contradicts its values and medians
a plotted position on the wrong side of 50
the five Strategic Index parts no longer sum to the index
a partner reason outside the enum (no word for it)
a sector key that is not one of the 33
a summary count that the cells do not give
a value without its display string
an Energy Security score on a sector the paper does not score
a placed sector whose Energy Security is not rankable
a caveat id outside the list
an in-sample sector's priority rank above the number of in-sample sectors (the 2026-10 rank-offset bug)
